caption: The drawing features two identical, vertically-oriented ornamental designs positioned side by side against a plain, light beige background. Each design is composed of symmetrical, scrolling, and interlocking shapes resembling stylized foliage or wrought ironwork, predominantly rendered in dark gray tones. The composition is centered on the paper, with ample blank space surrounding the design. At the bottom right of the image, there is a small handwritten inscription or signature in a lighter gray shade. The overall style is linear and precise, with consistent shading used to suggest volume and depth within the decorative patterns.
title: Platform Railing
